games.name: Reality Compromised
games.desc:
PLAY ON PC FOR BEST EXPERIENCE!

SOMEWHERE IN NEVADA....
Reality Compromised is a 1v12 shooter game, set in the Madness Combat universe. Play as deadly bosses such as Tricky the Clown and destroy everyone else, or team up to take down the boss!

Madness Combat is an action-packed, violent yet awesome web series created by Krinkels. Go check it out!
Updates every weekend

Controls:
Q - Dash
M1 - Attack
R - Reload
Shift - Walk (increases weapon accuracy)
G - Emote
K - Ragdoll (while not holding anything)

Also inspired by Madness: Project Nexus created by Krinkels and TheSwain

Like and favorite for more updates!
Thank you to the testers and everyone who is supporting this!
